summary: Suno's official pricing page lists a Free Plan at $0 that includes 50 credits renewing daily (about 10 songs), with up to 4 songs generated at once, no commercial use, no credit top-ups, and a shared generation queue. The page was fetched live on 2026-09-04 and the terms match the claim exactly. No end date is stated, so the offer appears ongoing.
claim_steps: Click Sign Up and create a free Suno account.
Use the Free Plan (no payment needed) — 50 credits renew daily (10 songs).
